caption: The drawing depicts a tall, cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly flared rim and two small, looped handles attached near the top on opposite sides. The body of the jar is a beige or light tan color with a smooth texture, and the interior is shown as a darker brown. Around the neck of the jar, three parallel horizontal grooves are visible, above which the text "H. L. WANDS OLEAN NY" is inscribed. Below the inscription, a blue painted number "4" appears. On the front of the jar, there is a painted decoration of a stylized bird, likely a rooster or peacock, in dark blue glaze, with flourishes suggesting feathers and tail plumes extending across the midsection of the jar. The background of the drawing is light and plain, focusing attention on the jar itself.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
